name: neocore
description: Sistema integral de reservas para centros de salud y bienestar

scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.migrate: docker-compose exec web python manage.py migrate
scripts.makemigrations: docker-compose exec web python manage.py makemigrations
scripts.createsuperuser: docker-compose exec web python manage.py createsuperuser
scripts.seed: docker-compose exec web python manage.py seed_data
scripts.shell: docker-compose exec web python manage.py shell
